context: M30 o6. Corwin lobby. Nick sits in the chair next to Odessa's. The radio plays. Residents watch from the stairs.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Mrs. Pruitt. I came inside. It's very hot in here.

lines.speaker: char.odessa_pruitt
lines.text: It's been hot in here since 1956, Mr. Varelas. You're the new thing.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: I can sell it on, keep it, or give it away to people who'll keep it housing.

lines.speaker: char.odessa_pruitt
lines.text: And which one are you, Mr. Varelas?

choices.text: Sell it on to Lisle's people.

choices.disabledText: You can't afford to keep it.
Mrs. Pruitt doesn't trust you yet.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: I have to sell. The bank. My wife. I'm sorry. October first.

lines.speaker: char.odessa_pruitt
lines.text: Then I'll be here October first. In this chair. Bring movers. Bring many.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: I keep it. New wiring. Real wiring. And a fan for every room on eleven.

lines.speaker: char.odessa_pruitt
lines.text: Fans. We'll see. A landlord who comes inside is a start.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: One dollar. The West Midtown Housing Council. It stays housing. Forever.

lines.speaker: char.odessa_pruitt
lines.text: Mr. Varelas. You're shorter than the paper. You're taller than I thought.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Nobody told me there were people in it. Now somebody has.
